name: Risei Houkai
source:
Moonburg is destroyed by a sudden attack in one night.
On the day of the destruction a feast of humiliation recurs in the castle.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE042207.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
月堡在一夜之间被突袭摧毁。在毁灭之日，一场屈辱的盛宴在城堡中重演。
